intent.raw_query: Bali for solo traveler, $1500 budget, beaches and yoga, July 2026 from LA

selected_hotel.name: Campuhan Ridge Walk, Ubud Boutique Stay

experiences.name: Sunrise Yoga at Campuhan Ridge Walk
experiences.description: Join an outdoor yoga session at the iconic Campuhan Ridge Walk in Ubud, surrounded by lush green hills and rice paddies. Many local instructors offer small group sessions here at dawn, combining gentle Hatha or Vinyasa flow with the serene natural backdrop. A deeply rejuvenating experience that blends movement with Bali's spiritual energy.

experiences.name: Seminyak Beach Sunset & Surf Lesson
experiences.description: Take a beginner-friendly surf lesson on the golden sands of Seminyak Beach, one of Bali's most beautiful and accessible surf spots. Certified instructors provide boards and safety guidance. Afterward, relax on a beach club sunbed and watch one of Bali's legendary sunsets over the Indian Ocean.

experiences.name: Yin Yoga & Healing Retreat Day at The Yoga Barn
experiences.description: Spend a full day at The Yoga Barn, Ubud's most celebrated wellness center. Attend a Yin Yoga class, a sound healing meditation session, and enjoy a healthy plant-based lunch at their Garden Kafe. The lush jungle setting and world-class instructors make this a bucket-list experience for yoga lovers.

experiences.name: Nusa Dua Crystal-Clear Beach Snorkeling
experiences.description: Explore the calm, turquoise waters of Nusa Dua, Bali's most pristine beach area. Rent snorkeling gear and discover vibrant coral reefs and tropical fish just offshore. The protected bay offers ideal conditions for beginners and families. Combine with a relaxing afternoon on the white sandy beach.

experiences.name: Balinese Cooking Class & Tanah Lot Temple Visit
experiences.description: Start your morning with a guided visit to the iconic sea temple of Tanah Lot perched dramatically on a coastal rock, then head to a nearby family-run cooking school to learn authentic Balinese cuisine. Prepare dishes like Nasi Goreng, Satay Lilit, and Lawar using fresh local ingredients from a traditional market. A perfect blend of culture, food, and spiritual heritage.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Bali
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Campuhan Ridge Walk, Ubud Boutique Stay

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — skip morning slot as flight lands at 1 PM
day_by_day.afternoon: Land at 13:00, clear customs and immigration, arrange a pre-booked budget shuttle or shared Grab ride to Campuhan Ridge Walk, Ubud Boutique Stay (~2 hrs). Check in, freshen up, and take a gentle stroll along the iconic Campuhan Ridge Walk trail just steps from the hotel — a free, scenic walk through lush green hills and rice paddies perfect for unwinding after the flight.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the quiet lanes around Campuhan and walk into central Ubud (~15 min walk). Visit the lively Ubud Night Market (Pasar Malam Ubud) for affordable local street food and a taste of Balinese culture.

meals.breakfast: Eat on the plane or grab a snack at the airport
meals.lunch: Quick bite at the airport or a warung (local eatery) near the hotel on arrival — nasi campur (mixed rice) for ~IDR 20,000–35,000
meals.dinner: Ubud Night Market — try sate lilit, pisang goreng, and fresh coconut water for under IDR 50,000 total

day_by_day.notes: Day 1 is purely arrival and orientation. Keep it light. Pre-book a shared shuttle from the airport to Ubud for ~IDR 80,000–100,000 per person to save money versus a private taxi.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for a sunrise Campuhan Ridge Walk (free entry) — the golden hour light over the hills is spectacular and the trail is cool and quiet in the morning. Approximately 2–3 km loop taking 45–60 minutes.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the iconic Tegalalang Rice Terraces (~20 min by scooter or cheap local ojek). Explore the terraced fields, take photos, and enjoy the scenery. Entry donation is around IDR 10,000–20,000. Rent a scooter for the day for ~IDR 60,000–80,000 for maximum flexibility.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud center. Browse Ubud Art Market (Pasar Seni Ubud) for souvenirs and local crafts. Watch the famous Kecak Fire Dance at Uluwatu or a local Legong dance performance at Ubud Palace (~IDR 80,000–100,000 per person).

meals.breakfast: Warung breakfast near the hotel — nasi goreng or bubur ayam (rice porridge) for IDR 20,000–30,000
meals.lunch: Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka in central Ubud — famous suckling pig dish for ~IDR 50,000–70,000
meals.dinner: Warung Teges or a simple local warung near Ubud Palace — mixed rice plate with vegetables and tempeh for IDR 25,000–40,000

day_by_day.notes: Renting a scooter is the most budget-friendly way to explore. Ensure you have an international driving permit. Wear sunscreen — warm summer weather with highs around 25°C.

day_by_day.morning: Join a budget morning yoga class in Ubud — many studios offer drop-in sessions for IDR 80,000–120,000 (e.g., Yoga Barn or smaller local studios near Campuhan). Start your day with a 90-minute Hatha or Vinyasa class.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Tirta Empul Temple (~20 min from Ubud) — a sacred Hindu water temple where locals and visitors participate in a purification ritual in the holy spring pools. Entry ~IDR 50,000. Dress respectfully (sarong provided at entrance).
day_by_day.evening: Head back to Campuhan area. Relax on the ridge at sunset. Visit a local café along the ridge for a relaxed evening with herbal Jamu drinks.

meals.breakfast: Smoothie bowl or avocado toast at a budget-friendly café near the yoga studio — IDR 35,000–55,000
meals.lunch: Warung near Tirta Empul — nasi campur for IDR 25,000–35,000
meals.dinner: Locavore To Go (budget-friendly sibling of the famous Locavore) — creative Indonesian street food for IDR 40,000–70,000 per dish

day_by_day.notes: Tirta Empul is spiritually significant — be respectful during the purification ritual. Avoid visiting during major Balinese religious ceremonies as it may be closed to tourists.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning visit to Gunung Kawi Temple complex in Tampaksiring (~25 min from Ubud) — ancient royal tomb shrines carved into rock cliffs surrounded by rice paddies. Entry ~IDR 50,000. Arrive before 9 AM to beat the crowds.
day_by_day.afternoon: Drive to Kintamani (about 45 min from Ubud by scooter) to see the dramatic views of Mount Batur volcano and Lake Batur. Walk along the crater rim viewpoint — free to access from the road. Enjoy the cool highland air.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud. Attend a free or low-cost meditation session (many guesthouses and small studios offer free community sessions). Wind down with a traditional Balinese herbal tea.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast if included, or local warung — fried rice and tea for IDR 20,000–30,000
meals.lunch: Warung at Kintamani with volcano views — set lunch (nasi campur) for IDR 30,000–50,000. Avoid overpriced tourist restaurants along the main strip.
meals.dinner: Warung Sopa in Ubud — vegetarian Balinese food, generous portions for IDR 35,000–60,000

day_by_day.notes: The Kintamani area can be slightly cooler (~20°C) due to elevation. Bring a light layer. The drive through the highlands is scenic and part of the experience.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga or stretching session on the Campuhan Ridge at sunrise (self-guided, free). Breathe in the fresh morning air and set intentions for the day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head south to Seminyak or Canggu beach (~1.5 hrs by scooter or IDR 100,000–150,000 by shared transport). Spend the afternoon at Echo Beach (Canggu) — a popular surf beach with a laid-back vibe. Swim, sunbathe, or try a beginner surf lesson (~IDR 150,000–200,000 including board rental).
day_by_day.evening: Watch the famous Bali sunset from the beach. Grab a Bintang beer or fresh coconut at a beachside warung. Explore the Canggu café and street food scene before heading back to Ubud.

meals.breakfast: Warung breakfast in Ubud before departure — eggs, toast, and juice for IDR 25,000–40,000
meals.lunch: Warung or beach shack in Canggu — grilled fish with rice for IDR 40,000–70,000
meals.dinner: Old Man's Bar & Restaurant in Canggu (happy hour deals) or a local warung for nasi goreng — IDR 40,000–80,000

day_by_day.notes: If staying in Ubud, arrange transport back in the evening (~IDR 100,000–150,000 for a shared Grab). July weather is ideal for beach days — low rain, warm and sunny.

day_by_day.morning: Visit Pura Taman Saraswati (Lotus Temple) in central Ubud — a beautiful Hindu temple with a large lotus pond, free to enter the outer area. Then explore the Ubud Monkey Forest Sanctuary (IDR 80,000 entry) — home to over 700 Balinese long-tailed macaques among ancient temple ruins.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a free self-guided walk through Ubud's traditional neighborhoods (Banjar). Peek into family compound temples and observe daily offerings (canang sari) being placed. Visit a local silversmith or woodcarving workshop in the Mas village area (~10 min south of Ubud) — most are free to browse.
day_by_day.evening: Catch a traditional Balinese dance performance at Ubud Palace (Puri Saren Agung) — performances run most evenings at 7:30 PM, tickets IDR 80,000–100,000. A must-do cultural experience.

meals.breakfast: Café Wayan in Ubud — healthy breakfast with fresh fruit and yogurt for IDR 35,000–55,000
meals.lunch: Warung near Monkey Forest — nasi campur or mie goreng for IDR 25,000–35,000
meals.dinner: Warung Ibu Oka or a simple rice and satay warung near Ubud Palace — IDR 30,000–50,000

day_by_day.notes: At Monkey Forest, do NOT bring food, bags with food, or shiny objects — the monkeys are bold and will snatch items. Keep belongings secure.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Amed (East Bali) — depart early by scooter or shared transport (~2 hrs). Amed is a quiet fishing village with black sand beaches and excellent snorkeling. Rent snorkeling gear (~IDR 30,000–50,000) and explore the vibrant coral reefs and the famous USAT Liberty shipwreck at nearby Tulamben.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue snorkeling or relax on Amed's quiet beach. The water is crystal clear in July — perfect visibility. Walk through the salt-making fields along the coast, a traditional local industry unique to this area.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset views from Amed beach are stunning with Mount Agung in the background. Head back to Ubud in the early evening (~2 hrs). Rest and recover.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast in Ubud before departure — banana pancakes and coffee for IDR 25,000–35,000
meals.lunch: Fresh seafood warung in Amed — grilled fish, rice, and vegetables for IDR 50,000–80,000
meals.dinner: Simple warung dinner back in Ubud — soup, rice, and tempeh for IDR 25,000–40,000

day_by_day.notes: Amed is a long but rewarding day trip. Start by 7 AM to maximize time. Alternatively, book a shared day-tour from Ubud for ~IDR 150,000–200,000 per person if not comfortable riding a scooter that far.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning. Enjoy a slow start with a self-practice yoga session in your room or on the hotel terrace overlooking the ridge. Journal, meditate, and recharge.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Penestanan neighborhood adjacent to Campuhan Ridge — a charming artistic enclave with galleries, organic cafés, and rice field paths. Visit a local painter's studio (many welcome visitors for free). Walk the scenic rice field path to Sari Organik farm.
day_by_day.evening: Visit Sari Organik restaurant (reached by a 20-min walk through rice fields) for a farm-to-table dinner experience at surprisingly affordable prices. Watch the sun set over the rice paddies.

meals.breakfast: In-room or hotel terrace — fruit, yogurt, and local coffee
meals.lunch: Café Pomegranate or a small café in Penestanan — healthy bowl or sandwich for IDR 40,000–60,000
meals.dinner: Sari Organik Restaurant in the rice fields — organic Indonesian dishes for IDR 50,000–90,000 per dish. Worth the walk!

day_by_day.notes: This is a deliberate slower day to avoid burnout mid-trip. Penestanan is walkable from your hotel — no transport needed. Great for photography enthusiasts.

day_by_day.morning: Early wake-up for a sunrise hike up Mount Batur (active volcano) — depart Ubud by 2:00 AM with a guided group tour (~IDR 350,000–450,000 including guide, breakfast at summit, and transport). Reach the summit at sunrise (~5:30 AM) for breathtaking panoramic views over the caldera and Lake Batur.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Ubud by midday. Stop at natural hot springs near Lake Batur for a relaxing soak (~IDR 50,000–100,000 entry) to soothe tired hiking muscles.
day_by_day.evening: Early dinner and early bedtime to recover from the pre-dawn hike. Gentle stretching or restorative yoga before sleep.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast is typically included at the summit as part of the Mount Batur tour (eggs cooked in volcanic steam — a unique experience!)
meals.lunch: Warung near the hot springs or back in Ubud — simple rice dish for IDR 25,000–40,000
meals.dinner: Light dinner at a local warung near the hotel — vegetable soup and rice for IDR 25,000–35,000

day_by_day.notes: Mount Batur hike is the highlight of many Bali trips. Book your guide the day before through your hotel or a local agency. Bring a headlamp, warm layer (summit can be cold at 3–4 AM), and good hiking shoes. The hike is moderate difficulty — 2 hrs up, 1.5 hrs down.

day_by_day.morning: Full recovery morning after the volcano hike. Sleep in, then enjoy a leisurely breakfast. Book an affordable traditional Balinese massage in Ubud (~IDR 80,000–120,000 for 60–90 min) at one of the many reputable local spas.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Goa Gajah (Elephant Cave Temple) just 4 km from Ubud center — an 11th-century archaeological site with a cave shrine, ancient bathing pools, and jungle surroundings. Entry ~IDR 50,000. Explore at a relaxed pace.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at the Campuhan Ridge Walk — your home trail. Bring a journal or book and sit on the ridge as the sky turns orange and pink. Perfect low-key evening.

meals.breakfast: Hotel or nearby warung — full Indonesian breakfast (nasi goreng, fried egg, fruit) for IDR 25,000–40,000
meals.lunch: Warung near Goa Gajah — rice and mixed dishes for IDR 25,000–40,000
meals.dinner: Warung Biah Biah in Ubud — traditional Balinese cuisine in a beautiful garden setting, affordable at IDR 50,000–90,000 per dish

day_by_day.notes: Today is intentionally relaxed. A massage is a great investment after the Batur hike. Avoid any strenuous activity — let your legs recover fully.

day_by_day.morning: Beach day at Balangan Beach (south Bali, ~1.5 hrs from Ubud). One of Bali's most beautiful and less-crowded beaches with dramatic limestone cliffs, white sand, and turquoise water. Entry ~IDR 5,000–10,000. Great for swimming and sunbathing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue south to Uluwatu Temple (Pura Luhur Uluwatu) perched dramatically on a 70-meter cliff above the Indian Ocean. Entry ~IDR 50,000. Explore the temple grounds and watch the waves crash below. Stay for the sunset Kecak Fire Dance performance at the clifftop amphitheater (~IDR 100,000).
day_by_day.evening: Watch the stunning Kecak Fire Dance at sunset — a mesmerizing traditional Balinese performance with the ocean as a backdrop. Head back to Ubud afterward.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast in Ubud before departure — IDR 25,000–40,000
meals.lunch: Beachside warung at Balangan — fresh grilled corn, coconut, and snacks for IDR 30,000–50,000
meals.dinner: Jimbaran seafood warungs on the way back — fresh grilled seafood set meals on the beach for IDR 80,000–150,000 (a splurge but worth it)

day_by_day.notes: Balangan and Uluwatu are best combined in one day trip. Depart Ubud by 8 AM. Watch your belongings at Uluwatu — monkeys here are notorious thieves (especially glasses and hats).

day_by_day.morning: Final morning yoga session — book a special class at Yoga Barn (one of Bali's most famous yoga centers) for a memorable session. Choose from Vinyasa, Yin, or a Balinese healing class (~IDR 120,000–150,000 drop-in).
day_by_day.afternoon: Last-minute souvenir shopping at Ubud Art Market — bargain for handmade crafts, batik fabrics, silver jewelry, and wooden carvings. Budget IDR 100,000–300,000 for gifts. Then visit Blanco Renaissance Museum (IDR 80,000 entry) — a stunning artist's home-museum with dramatic architecture and Balinese-influenced paintings.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner in Ubud. Splurge slightly on your last evening — visit a mid-range restaurant with a beautiful rice field view for a special send-off meal.

meals.breakfast: Smoothie bowl and coffee at a Ubud café — IDR 40,000–60,000
meals.lunch: Quick warung lunch while shopping — nasi campur for IDR 25,000–35,000
meals.dinner: Mozaic Restaurant Brasserie (more affordable sibling of the famous Mozaic) or Bridges Restaurant overlooking the Campuhan river gorge — IDR 100,000–200,000 per person for a special farewell meal

day_by_day.notes: Pack your bags tonight. Confirm your airport transport for Day 13. This is a great day to reflect on your Bali journey and pick up any last souvenirs. Bargaining is expected at the Art Market — start at 50% of the asking price.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise walk on the Campuhan Ridge — one last time. Soak in the peaceful green landscape, say goodbye to Ubud, and take your last photos. Check out of the hotel and arrange transport to the airport.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depart for Ngurah Rai International Airport (allow 2–2.5 hrs from Ubud depending on traffic). Check in and browse the airport for any last-minute Balinese snacks or duty-free items to bring home.
day_by_day.evening: Board your departure flight. Carry wonderful memories, a rested body from yoga, sun-kissed skin from the beaches, and a deeper connection to Balinese culture.

meals.breakfast: Final warung breakfast in Ubud — nasi goreng and Bali coffee for IDR 25,000–40,000
meals.lunch: Airport meal or pack a snack from a local warung before leaving — IDR 30,000–60,000
meals.dinner: On the flight

day_by_day.notes: Book airport transport the night before — shared shuttle ~IDR 100,000 or Grab ~IDR 150,000–200,000. Arrive at the airport at least 2.5–3 hours before international departure. Check baggage weight limits if you've purchased souvenirs.

trip_options.title: Classic Bali Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

hotel.name: Campuhan Ridge Walk, Ubud Boutique Stay

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled. Arrange private transfer or Grab car to Campuhan Ridge Walk, Ubud Boutique Stay (approx. 1.5–2 hrs drive). Enjoy the scenic rice terrace views along the way.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check in to the boutique stay, freshen up, and take a gentle introductory stroll along the iconic Campuhan Ridge Walk (flat, well-paved path). Soak in panoramic views of the lush jungle valley and the Wos River below.
day_by_day.evening: Explore Jalan Raya Campuhan and Jalan Raya Ubud on foot. Visit the nearby Pura Gunung Lebah temple at dusk for a serene cultural first impression.

meals.breakfast: N/A — in-flight meal
meals.lunch: Grab a light snack or nasi campur at a warung near the airport or on the road to Ubud
meals.dinner: Mozaic Restaurant Brasserie (Jalan Raya Sanggingan) — mid-range Indonesian-French fusion; try the grilled fish with sambal matah

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light to recover from travel. Exchange currency at the airport or use a BCA/Mandiri ATM in Ubud for better rates. Confirm hotel check-in time in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga session at Radiantly Alive Yoga Studio or Intuitive Flow (both within 10 min walk/ride from Campuhan). Choose a beginner-friendly Hatha or Vinyasa class (approx. IDR 120,000–150,000). Followed by a healthy breakfast at the studio café.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Neka Art Museum (15 min walk from hotel) to explore Balinese and Indonesian contemporary paintings. Then wander through the Campuhan Ridge Walk again, this time heading further toward Bangkiang Sidem village for a deeper jungle experience.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Kecak Fire Dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud (starts at 19:30, approx. IDR 100,000–150,000 per person). A mesmerizing cultural highlight.

meals.breakfast: Kafe (Jalan Hanoman) — acai bowls, smoothies, and Balinese coffee; mid-range, health-focused
meals.lunch: Warung Ibu Oka (famous babi guling/suckling pig) — local institution, very affordable
meals.dinner: Locavore To Go or Hujon Locale (Jalan Sri Wedari) — creative Indonesian sharing plates, mid-range

day_by_day.notes: Book the Kecak Dance tickets in advance during peak July season. Bring a light layer for the evening open-air amphitheater.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning visit to Tirta Empul Temple (holy spring water temple, 30 min drive from Ubud). Participate in the melukat purification ritual — wear a sarong (available to rent at the gate). Arrive by 08:00 to beat the crowds.
day_by_day.afternoon: Stop at Tegallalang Rice Terraces on the way back (20 min from Tirta Empul). Walk the terraced paths, take photos, and try the famous Bali swing for memorable views (IDR 50,000–150,000 depending on swing type). Return to hotel for a midday rest.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset drinks and dinner along Jalan Bisma, overlooking the jungle ravine. The area is a short walk from the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or Seniman Coffee Studio (Jalan Sriwedari) — specialty Balinese single-origin coffee and toast
meals.lunch: Warung Teges near Tegallalang — simple nasi goreng or mie goreng, very local and affordable
meals.dinner: Swept Away at COMO Uma Ubud (Jalan Bisma) — elegant but accessible; grilled seafood and Indonesian classics with valley views

day_by_day.notes: Wear modest clothing for Tirta Empul (shoulders and knees covered). Sarongs are available at the entrance. Bring water shoes for the purification pools.

day_by_day.morning: Morning Yin Yoga or meditation class at The Yoga Barn (Jalan Hanoman, 15 min ride) — one of Bali's most celebrated wellness centers. Book a 2-hour class (IDR 130,000–160,000). Explore their healing garden and crystal shop afterward.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Ubud Art Market (Pasar Seni Ubud) and Ubud Palace (Puri Saren Agung) — both in the center of Ubud, 20 min ride. Browse handmade batik, silver jewelry, and wood carvings. Practice gentle bargaining.
day_by_day.evening: Catch a Legong Dance performance at Ubud Palace (starts 19:30). The palace courtyard setting is magical under torchlight.

meals.breakfast: The Yoga Barn Garden Café — smoothie bowls, granola, and herbal teas post-class
meals.lunch: Warung Biah Biah (Jalan Gautama) — authentic Balinese home cooking, very affordable and delicious
meals.dinner: Bridges Bali (Jalan Campuhan) — romantic riverside setting near the hotel; wood-fired dishes and cocktails, mid-range

day_by_day.notes: The Yoga Barn has a packed schedule — check their website and book your preferred class online at least a day ahead. The Ubud Art Market is best visited before 10:00 for fewer crowds.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to Mount Batur for a sunrise trek (depart hotel at 02:00). Guided hike to the active volcano summit (1,717 m) takes about 2 hours. Watch the sunrise above the clouds over Lake Batur — one of Bali's most iconic experiences. (Guided trek: IDR 300,000–450,000 per person)
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend and soak in the natural hot springs at Toya Devasya or Tirta Sari Hot Springs near Lake Batur. Relax tired muscles before the drive back to Ubud (1.5 hrs).
day_by_day.evening: Early, relaxed evening back in Ubud. Treat yourself to a traditional Balinese massage at Karsa Spa or Taksu Spa (IDR 150,000–250,000 for 60–90 min).

meals.breakfast: Eggs and toast cooked on the volcano summit by your guide — a unique Mt. Batur tradition included in most tour packages
meals.lunch: Warung by Lake Batur — fresh grilled fish (ikan bakar) and rice, extremely affordable
meals.dinner: Room service or light meal at hotel; alternatively Naughty Nuri's Warung (Jalan Raya Sanggingan) — famous ribs and cocktails

day_by_day.notes: This is a physically demanding day. Book a reputable licensed guide through your hotel or HPPGB (official Mt. Batur guide association). Bring a warm layer — summit temperatures can drop to 10°C before sunrise.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning. Gentle walk along the Campuhan Ridge Walk at your own pace, or join a morning restorative yoga class at Intuitive Flow. Visit the nearby ARMA (Agung Rai Museum of Art) for a calm cultural immersion.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a cooking class at Casa Luna Cooking School or Paon Bali (both near Ubud center, IDR 300,000–450,000). Learn to make traditional Balinese dishes like lawar, sate lilit, and black rice pudding.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the meal you cooked! Most classes end with a feast. Stroll along Monkey Forest Road for evening people-watching and browse local boutiques.

meals.breakfast: Café Wayan (Jalan Monkey Forest) — classic banana pancakes and fresh fruit platter, Ubud institution
meals.lunch: Light snack before cooking class — Bali Buda (Jalan Jembawan) for healthy wraps and juices
meals.dinner: Feast from your cooking class, or Warung Sopa (Jalan Sudamala) — vegetarian Balinese cuisine, mid-range

day_by_day.notes: Day 6 is intentionally lighter after the Mt. Batur trek. The cooking class is a great way to engage actively without physical exertion. Book Casa Luna in advance as classes fill quickly.

day_by_day.morning: Travel day to South Bali coast (Seminyak/Canggu area, approx. 1.5 hrs drive — arrange private driver through hotel, ~IDR 350,000). Check into a mid-range beach guesthouse or surf hotel in Canggu for a 2-night beach break.
day_by_day.afternoon: First beach afternoon at Echo Beach or Batu Bolong Beach (Canggu). Rent a surfboard or take a beginner surf lesson (IDR 200,000–300,000 per hour with instructor). The July swells are ideal for learning.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at La Brisa Beach Club or The Lawn Canggu — beachfront sunset cocktails with live music. Relaxed, barefoot-chic atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at hotel before departure — or stop at Titik Dua Coffee (en route) for Bali coffee and pastries
meals.lunch: Warung Dandelion (Canggu) — healthy bowls and fresh juices, very popular with surfers
meals.dinner: Betelnut Café (Jalan Pantai Batu Bolong) — Asian fusion, great cocktails, mid-range

day_by_day.notes: Arrange the private driver through your Ubud hotel the night before. Confirm beach guesthouse check-in time. Canggu has a very different vibe from Ubud — more lively and beach-oriented.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga on the beach or join a beach yoga class at Serenity Eco Guesthouse or Desa Seni (Canggu) — world-class outdoor yoga pavilions with ocean breeze (IDR 130,000–180,000).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Seminyak (20 min south of Canggu). Visit Seminyak Beach and Petitenget Beach. Browse the high-street boutiques along Jalan Oberoi and Jalan Kayu Aya for Balinese fashion and homeware.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at Ku De Ta or Potato Head Beach Club (Seminyak) — iconic Bali sunset spots. Book a table in advance for peak July season.

meals.breakfast: Milk & Madu (Canggu) — avocado toast, eggs benedict, excellent coffee
meals.lunch: Sisterfields (Seminyak) — popular brunch café; chicken schnitzel or grain bowls, mid-range
meals.dinner: Sarong Restaurant (Jalan Petitenget, Seminyak) — award-winning Asian-inspired fine dining, splurge option; or Merah Putih for upscale Indonesian at mid-range prices

day_by_day.notes: July is peak season in Seminyak — beach clubs can be crowded. Arrive at Potato Head by 16:30 to secure a good sunset spot. Wear sunscreen; UV index is high even on partly cloudy days.

day_by_day.morning: Travel south to the Bukit Peninsula (30 min from Canggu). Visit Uluwatu Temple perched dramatically on a 70-meter cliff above the Indian Ocean. Arrive early (09:00) to explore before tour groups arrive.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head down to Padang Padang Beach or Bingin Beach — two of Bali's most beautiful and photogenic beaches. Swim, snorkel, or simply relax on the white sand. Bring snorkeling gear (rentable on-site, IDR 30,000–50,000).
day_by_day.evening: Return to Uluwatu for the famous Kecak Fire Dance at sunset (starts 18:00, IDR 100,000–150,000). Dine at Single Fin or Ulu Cliffhouse for dramatic clifftop ocean views.

meals.breakfast: Drifter Surf Shop & Café (Seminyak) before departing — açaí bowls and cold brew
meals.lunch: Thomas Beach Café (Uluwatu) or warung at Padang Padang — fresh coconut water and grilled corn on the beach
meals.dinner: Single Fin Restaurant (Uluwatu) — burgers, fish tacos, and cocktails with sunset surf views; mid-range

day_by_day.notes: Wear a sarong at Uluwatu Temple (provided at entrance). Watch out for the resident monkeys — they are known to snatch sunglasses, hats, and phones. Keep belongings secured.

day_by_day.morning: Return to Ubud (approx. 1.5–2 hrs). Check back into the Campuhan Ridge Walk boutique stay. Decompress with a morning walk along the ridge and visit the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary (Jalan Monkey Forest, IDR 80,000 entry).
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in a full spa afternoon at Karsa Spa (Jalan Raya Kedewatan) — set in a lush jungle ravine 10 min from hotel. Book a 2-hour package: Balinese massage + flower bath + body scrub (IDR 350,000–500,000).
day_by_day.evening: Attend a sound healing or cacao ceremony at The Yoga Barn or Pyramids of Chi (Jalan Raya Lungsiakan) — deeply restorative Balinese wellness experience (IDR 150,000–250,000).

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast at hotel or grab-and-go from Bali Buda
meals.lunch: Warung Ibu Mangku (near Monkey Forest) — home-style Balinese cooking, very local
meals.dinner: Room4Dessert or Locavore (Jalan Dewi Sita) — innovative tasting menus showcasing Indonesian ingredients; book well in advance

day_by_day.notes: Locavore is one of Asia's 50 Best Restaurants — reservations are essential and should be made weeks ahead. If unavailable, their casual sister venue 'Locavore To Go' is a great alternative.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning visit to Pura Luhur Batukaru Temple on the slopes of Mount Batukaru (1.5 hrs from Ubud). One of Bali's most sacred and atmospheric temples, surrounded by ancient jungle. Hire a local guide for context (IDR 100,000–150,000).
day_by_day.afternoon: Stop at Jatiluwih Rice Terraces UNESCO World Heritage Site on the return journey (30 min from Batukaru). Walk the 5 km trail through emerald green subak irrigation terraces. Entry fee IDR 40,000.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset at Pura Taman Ayun (Mengwi Royal Temple, 45 min from Ubud) — a moated royal temple surrounded by lotus ponds, beautiful at golden hour.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast — fuel up for a full day of exploration
meals.lunch: Warung Jatiluwih — local restaurant with panoramic terrace rice field views; nasi campur and fresh coconut
meals.dinner: Bebek Bengil (Dirty Duck Diner, Jalan Hanoman, Ubud) — legendary crispy duck restaurant, mid-range and iconic

day_by_day.notes: This is a full-day cultural and nature excursion. Hire a private driver for the day (IDR 500,000–700,000 all-inclusive). Bring cash for temple entrance fees and guide tips. Comfortable walking shoes essential.

day_by_day.morning: Final full yoga morning — attend a special workshop or 90-minute advanced class at The Yoga Barn or Radiantly Alive. Then visit the Blanco Renaissance Museum (Campuhan area, 5 min walk from hotel) — a beautiful hilltop museum dedicated to Spanish-Balinese artist Antonio Blanco.
day_by_day.afternoon: Last-minute souvenir shopping along Jalan Raya Ubud and Jalan Monkey Forest. Visit Threads of Life (Jalan Kajeng) for ethically sourced traditional textiles, or Kou Cuisine for handmade soaps and gifts. Pack and prepare for departure.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell sunset dinner at a special venue. Take a short walk along the Campuhan Ridge Walk one final time at golden hour — arguably the most beautiful light of the day.

meals.breakfast: Seniman Coffee Studio — specialty coffee and Balinese breakfast one last time
meals.lunch: Warung Tepi Sungai (Jalan Bisma) — riverside warung with local dishes and jungle views
meals.dinner: Mozaic Restaurant (Jalan Raya Sanggingan) — Ubud's most celebrated fine-dining experience; tasting menu with wine pairing. A memorable farewell splurge (IDR 800,000–1,200,000 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Confirm airport transfer for the following day. Mozaic requires advance reservations — book at least 3–4 days ahead. Pack light items purchased during the trip carefully to avoid baggage issues.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise walk along the Campuhan Ridge Walk — a peaceful, reflective farewell to Ubud. Return for hotel breakfast and complete checkout. Arrange private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport (depart Ubud by 10:00 for afternoon/evening flights, or adjust based on flight time).
day_by_day.afternoon: If time permits before transfer, stop at Seminyak for a final beach walk or quick lunch. Alternatively, explore the airport's duty-free for last-minute Balinese coffee, chocolate, or Luwak coffee gifts.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Ngurah Rai International Airport. Reflect on 13 days of beaches, yoga, culture, and Balinese magic.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast — final Balinese spread with tropical fruits and jamu (herbal tonic)
meals.lunch: Naughty Nuri's Warung (quick stop if time allows) or airport restaurant
meals.dinner: Airport dining or in-flight meal

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before international departure for check-in and immigration at Ngurah Rai Airport, especially during peak July season. Confirm transfer booking the night before. Keep IDR for any last tips or airport incidentals.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Bali Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

hotel.name: Campuhan Ridge Walk, Ubud Boutique Stay

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight LH arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Private airport transfer to Campuhan Ridge Walk Boutique Stay in Ubud. Check in, freshen up, and enjoy a welcome drink on your private villa terrace. Take a gentle stroll along the iconic Campuhan Ridge Walk trail to soak in the lush green valley views and decompress after the flight.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the hotel's infinity pool overlooking the jungle canopy, followed by a relaxed first dinner on-property to ease into Bali time.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable (in-flight)
meals.lunch: Not applicable (in-flight or airport)
meals.dinner: Dinner at Bridges Bali — a landmark fine-dining restaurant perched over the Campuhan River gorge, renowned for its contemporary Asian-European cuisine and dramatic jungle setting. Reserve a table by the river for a magical first night.

day_by_day.notes: Arrange a private air-conditioned car transfer in advance. Ask the hotel for a late check-in amenity or room upgrade as a welcome gesture. Keep the evening light — jet lag management is key for a 13-day premium experience.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga session at a premium Ubud yoga studio — book a private class at The Yoga Barn or Radiantly Alive, both a short drive from Campuhan. Opt for a Hatha or Vinyasa flow session with a certified instructor, followed by a guided pranayama (breathwork) practice to align body and mind in Bali.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the Campuhan Ridge Walk trail at leisure during the cooler afternoon hours. Continue into the village of Bangkiang Sidem, visiting local artisan workshops producing traditional Balinese silver jewelry and wood carvings. Stop at a boutique gallery in central Ubud to browse contemporary Balinese art.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Kecak Fire Dance performance at Pura Dalem Ubud temple — one of Bali's most atmospheric cultural experiences performed at dusk.

meals.breakfast: In-hotel breakfast — fresh tropical fruit platters, Balinese black rice porridge (bubur injin), eggs Benedict, and freshly pressed juice on your private terrace.
meals.lunch: Locavore NXT — the casual sibling of Ubud's world-renowned Locavore restaurant, offering a plant-forward, locally sourced menu in a relaxed but premium setting.
meals.dinner: Room4Dessert by Will Goldfarb — an internationally acclaimed dessert-focused tasting experience and one of Bali's most unique fine-dining destinations. Book well in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Pre-book yoga class and Kecak performance tickets. The ridge walk is best done before 09:00 or after 16:00 to avoid midday heat. Wear comfortable walking shoes and bring a light layer for the evening performance.

day_by_day.morning: Private Balinese cooking class hosted by a local chef at a traditional family compound near Ubud. Begin with a guided visit to Ubud's Pasar Pagi morning market to select fresh spices, herbs, and ingredients, then return to the compound to prepare a full Balinese feast including satay lilit, lawar, and black rice pudding.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in a luxury spa afternoon at COMO Shambhala Estate — one of Asia's most prestigious wellness retreats, located minutes from Campuhan. Book a signature two-hour treatment combining traditional Balinese massage with herbal poultices and a flower petal bath ritual.
day_by_day.evening: Private sunset dinner experience — arrange with your hotel concierge for a candlelit jungle dinner set up along the Campuhan ridge or a riverside terrace, curated with a private chef and butler service.

meals.breakfast: In-hotel breakfast on your terrace — avocado toast with Balinese smoked salt, fresh papaya, cold brew coffee, and a selection of local herbal teas.
meals.lunch: Enjoy the dishes prepared during your cooking class as a celebratory feast with your hosts.
meals.dinner: Private in-villa or ridge-side dining experience curated by your hotel — a bespoke 5-course menu featuring Balinese and Indonesian flavors paired with premium wines.

day_by_day.notes: COMO Shambhala treatments require advance booking — contact the spa at least 3–5 days before arrival. The private dinner setup should be arranged with the hotel concierge upon check-in.

day_by_day.morning: Private sunrise yoga and meditation session on the Campuhan Ridge — arrange with your hotel for a personal instructor to guide you through a 90-minute practice as the mist lifts over the valley. Follow with a guided meditation focused on Balinese Hindu spiritual traditions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Day trip to Tegalalang Rice Terraces (20 minutes from Ubud) — explore the UNESCO-listed UNESCO-recognized subak irrigation landscape. Continue to Tirta Empul Temple for a sacred purification water ritual (melukat) — a deeply meaningful Balinese spiritual experience. Dress respectfully and hire a local guide for cultural context.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Ubud for a leisurely evening exploring Jalan Hanoman's boutique shops, picking up premium Balinese textiles, natural skincare products, and handcrafted souvenirs.

meals.breakfast: In-hotel breakfast — Balinese nasi goreng (fried rice) with free-range egg, fresh fruit, and cold-pressed green juice.
meals.lunch: Sari Organik — a beloved farm-to-table restaurant set amid rice paddies between Ubud and Tegalalang, accessible via a scenic walk through the fields. Exceptional organic Indonesian cuisine.
meals.dinner: Merah Putih — a stunning fine-dining restaurant in Seminyak (if desired as an excursion) or alternatively Hujan Locale in Ubud, celebrating regional Indonesian cuisines in an elegant setting with craft cocktails.

day_by_day.notes: Bring a sarong for the temple visit — these are also available for rent at the temple entrance. The melukat ritual is optional but highly recommended as a premium cultural experience. Hire a knowledgeable local guide for Tirta Empul.

day_by_day.morning: Private Yin Yoga and sound healing session at your boutique stay or a nearby premium wellness studio. A certified practitioner will guide a 90-minute deep-stretch session followed by a 30-minute Tibetan singing bowl sound bath — deeply restorative for body and nervous system.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Blanco Renaissance Museum — the flamboyant former home and studio of Spanish-Balinese artist Antonio Blanco, perched dramatically above the Campuhan River. Explore the collection of erotic and romantic Balinese paintings in a lush garden setting. Continue to Neka Art Museum for a comprehensive overview of Balinese and Indonesian fine art.
day_by_day.evening: Private car to Pura Luhur Batukaru or enjoy a curated evening at the hotel with a Balinese Jamu wellness ritual — traditional herbal tonics prepared and served by a local healer.

meals.breakfast: In-hotel breakfast — smoothie bowls with dragon fruit, granola, and local honey; poached eggs on sourdough; freshly brewed Balinese kopi.
meals.lunch: Mozaic Restaurant Ubud — Chef Chris Salans' legendary fine-dining establishment offering an extraordinary tasting menu blending French technique with Indonesian ingredients. One of Bali's most celebrated restaurants.
meals.dinner: Swept Away at COMO Shambhala Estate — an open-air riverside restaurant serving health-conscious gourmet cuisine in an impossibly romantic jungle setting.

day_by_day.notes: Mozaic is one of Bali's hardest reservations to secure — book at least 2 weeks in advance. The Blanco Museum has a small entrance fee and is best visited on a weekday to avoid crowds.

day_by_day.morning: Private day trip to Bali's north coast — depart early for Lovina Beach (approximately 2.5 hours by private car). Enjoy a sunrise dolphin watching boat excursion in the calm, warm waters of the Bali Sea — a magical and rare wildlife encounter unique to this part of the island.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue to the Sekumpul Waterfalls — Bali's most spectacular waterfall complex, set deep in the jungle. A guided trek (approximately 45 minutes each way) leads to multiple cascades plunging into emerald pools. Swim in the natural pools surrounded by lush rainforest.
day_by_day.evening: Return journey to Ubud with a stop at a scenic viewpoint for sunset. Arrive back at the hotel for a relaxing evening with an in-room massage booked through the concierge.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at the hotel before departure — fresh fruit, yogurt, and Balinese coffee.
meals.lunch: Picnic lunch prepared by your hotel — premium bento-style boxes with Balinese snacks, sandwiches, fresh fruit, and chilled drinks, enjoyed at Sekumpul Waterfalls.
meals.dinner: In-hotel dining or room service — a curated selection from the hotel's premium menu enjoyed on your private terrace under the stars.

day_by_day.notes: Depart by 05:30 for the dolphin watching to catch the optimal sunrise window. Wear water shoes or sturdy sandals for the waterfall trek. The hotel kitchen can prepare a premium picnic box with advance notice the evening before.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and rejuvenation morning — sleep in, enjoy a leisurely in-hotel breakfast, and spend time by the pool or on your terrace journaling or reading. Optional: a 60-minute private stretch and mobility session with the hotel's in-house wellness practitioner.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private transfer to Seminyak and Canggu for a beach afternoon — Bali's most stylish coastal neighborhoods. Spend the afternoon at a premium beach club: Finns Beach Club in Canggu or Ku De Ta in Seminyak, with a private daybed, butler service, and ocean views.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at Potato Head Beach Club — one of Bali's most iconic sunset venues with a stunning amphitheater design facing the Indian Ocean. Followed by dinner in Seminyak before returning to Ubud.

meals.breakfast: Extended in-hotel breakfast — eggs any style, freshly baked pastries, tropical fruit selection, cold brew, and fresh juices.
meals.lunch: La Brisa Bali — a stunning driftwood beach restaurant in Echo Beach, Canggu, with an exceptional seafood menu and romantic rustic-chic design.
meals.dinner: Sarong Restaurant Seminyak — an award-winning fine-dining destination with a glamorous colonial-inspired interior and a sophisticated pan-Asian tasting menu.

day_by_day.notes: The drive from Ubud to Seminyak/Canggu takes approximately 1 hour. Book beach club daybeds in advance, especially on weekends. Arrange a private return transfer to Ubud for the evening — traffic can be heavy after sunset.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise Vinyasa yoga class at The Yoga Barn — join a premium group class or book a private session with one of Ubud's most sought-after teachers. Follow with a nourishing post-yoga breakfast and a visit to the on-site healing garden.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private cultural tour of Ubud's royal heritage — visit Puri Saren Agung (Ubud Royal Palace), the Saraswati Temple (Pura Taman Saraswati) with its spectacular lotus pond, and the Ubud Art Market for premium batik textiles and handwoven ikat fabrics. Engage a knowledgeable local guide for rich historical and spiritual context.
day_by_day.evening: Traditional Legong Dance performance at Ubud Royal Palace — held regularly in the palace's open courtyard, this elegant classical Balinese dance form is one of the island's greatest cultural treasures.

meals.breakfast: Post-yoga breakfast at The Yoga Barn Café — açaí bowls, avocado toast, turmeric lattes, and raw energy balls.
meals.lunch: Alaya Resort Ubud's restaurant — a serene, beautifully designed space offering refined Indonesian and international cuisine in a lush garden setting.
meals.dinner: Aperitivo at a rooftop bar followed by dinner at Locavore — Ubud's most acclaimed fine-dining restaurant, ranked among Asia's 50 Best Restaurants, offering a creative tasting menu of Indonesian ingredients interpreted through a modern European lens. Essential booking months in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Locavore reservations open 2–3 months in advance and fill extremely quickly — this should be booked before the trip begins. The Royal Palace dance performance tickets can be purchased at the gate but arrive early for good seats.

day_by_day.morning: Private sunrise trekking experience at Mount Batur — depart at 02:00 from Ubud for the 2-hour drive to Kintamani. Guided summit trek (approximately 2 hours) to reach the 1,717m volcanic peak for a breathtaking sunrise over the caldera lake. A once-in-a-lifetime Bali experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend and visit the natural hot springs at Toya Devasya — a luxury hot spring resort on the shores of Lake Batur, perfect for soaking tired muscles in mineral-rich volcanic waters with stunning caldera views. Return to Ubud for an afternoon rest.
day_by_day.evening: Gentle restorative yoga session followed by an early evening Balinese traditional massage at the hotel spa — a well-earned recovery after the morning trek.

meals.breakfast: Packed breakfast prepared by the hotel — energy bars, fruit, sandwiches, and a thermos of hot coffee consumed at the summit of Mount Batur as the sun rises.
meals.lunch: Toya Devasya Resort restaurant — a buffet lunch overlooking Lake Batur, featuring Balinese and Indonesian specialties.
meals.dinner: Light, nourishing dinner at the hotel or nearby — fresh seafood, steamed vegetables, and herbal tonics to support recovery.

day_by_day.notes: The Mount Batur trek requires advance booking with a certified guide — arrange through the hotel concierge. Bring warm layers, a headlamp, and sturdy trekking shoes. The 02:00 departure is non-negotiable for the sunrise. This day is physically demanding — plan a restful day the following day.

day_by_day.morning: Full rest and wellness recovery morning — sleep in, enjoy a long breakfast, and spend the morning at the hotel's pool or garden. Optional: a 90-minute deep tissue massage or Balinese boreh (herbal body scrub) treatment at the hotel spa to relieve post-trek muscle fatigue.
day_by_day.afternoon: Gentle afternoon exploring the Campuhan Ridge Walk at a leisurely pace — bring a sketchbook or camera to capture the sweeping valley views. Visit a local healer (balian) for a traditional Balinese energy healing session — arrange through the hotel concierge for an authentic and respectful experience.
day_by_day.evening: Private sunset cocktail experience arranged by the hotel on the ridge or villa terrace, followed by a quiet, elegant dinner.

meals.breakfast: Extended in-hotel breakfast — full spread of tropical fruits, freshly baked bread, eggs, and premium Balinese coffee.
meals.lunch: Café Pomegranate or a similar healthy café near Campuhan — light, nourishing bowls, fresh juices, and raw desserts.
meals.dinner: Bridges Bali — revisit this stunning riverside restaurant for a more leisurely and indulgent dinner experience, exploring the full à la carte menu with a wine pairing.

day_by_day.notes: A recovery day is essential after the Mount Batur trek. The balian (traditional healer) experience is deeply personal — ensure your guide or concierge arranges a reputable and respectful practitioner. Bring a small offering (canang sari) as a gesture of respect.

day_by_day.morning: Private transfer to Nusa Dua for a premium beach day — Bali's most exclusive coastal enclave on the southern Bukit Peninsula. Check into a day pass at a five-star resort (St. Regis Bali or Mulia Resort) for access to their pristine private beach, infinity pools, and beach butler service.
day_by_day.afternoon: Water sports and ocean activities — choose from stand-up paddleboarding, snorkeling, or a private catamaran sailing excursion along the Bukit Peninsula coastline. Alternatively, visit the stunning Pandawa Beach — a dramatic white-sand beach carved into limestone cliffs, one of Bali's most beautiful coastal discoveries.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset dinner at Sundara at Four Seasons Jimbaran — a world-class beachfront restaurant with feet-in-the-sand dining, fresh seafood, and an extraordinary sunset over Jimbaran Bay. One of Bali's most romantic dining experiences.

meals.breakfast: In-hotel breakfast in Ubud before departure.
meals.lunch: Beach club lunch at the St. Regis or Mulia Resort — fresh seafood platters, premium sushi, tropical cocktails, and chilled coconuts served by your beach butler.
meals.dinner: Sundara Beach Club & Restaurant at Four Seasons Jimbaran — grilled lobster, fresh catch of the day, and handcrafted cocktails as the sun melts into the Indian Ocean.

day_by_day.notes: Day passes at St. Regis or Mulia must be booked in advance and include a food and beverage credit. The drive from Ubud to Nusa Dua/Jimbaran takes approximately 1 hour — depart by 09:00 to maximize beach time. Arrange a private return transfer to Ubud after dinner.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning yoga and meditation session — a private 2-hour yoga retreat experience at a premium Ubud studio or in your villa, combining asana, pranayama, and a closing meditation to integrate the spiritual and physical journey of the past 12 days. Journaling and intention-setting to close the trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Luxury shopping and last-minute exploration in Ubud — visit JJ Bali Button for premium Balinese fashion, Ganesha Bookshop for curated literature on Balinese culture, and Kou Cuisine for artisan Balinese soaps and natural skincare products. Stop for a final visit to Pura Taman Saraswati to offer gratitude.
day_by_day.evening: Premium farewell dinner — a special celebration of the journey with a bespoke dining experience.

meals.breakfast: Celebratory in-hotel breakfast — champagne, fresh tropical fruits, eggs Benedict with smoked salmon, and freshly brewed single-origin Balinese coffee.
meals.lunch: Alaya Ubud or Kafe Ubud — a refined final lunch in Ubud's most elegant settings, savoring Balinese classics one last time.
meals.dinner: Mozaic Restaurant Ubud — if not visited earlier, this is the ideal farewell dinner venue. Chef Chris Salans' extraordinary tasting menu with wine pairings is a fitting and memorable conclusion to a premium Bali journey.

day_by_day.notes: Allow time for packing and final hotel checkout procedures. Ask the hotel concierge to arrange a premium farewell gift or in-room turndown surprise for the final evening. Confirm airport transfer details for the following morning.

day_by_day.morning: Gentle final morning — wake early for a last sunrise walk along the Campuhan Ridge, breathing in the misty Ubud valley air and savoring the final moments of the journey. Return for a quiet breakfast and complete packing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private premium transfer to Ngurah Rai International Airport (Denpasar) — approximately 1.5 hours from Ubud. Allow extra time for traffic. Access the premium airport lounge for a comfortable pre-departure experience with refreshments and Wi-Fi.
day_by_day.evening: Departure — carry the spirit of Bali home.

meals.breakfast: Final in-hotel breakfast — keep it light and nourishing: fresh fruit, yogurt, Balinese herbal tea, and a farewell slice of black rice cake.
meals.lunch: Airport lounge or a light meal at the terminal — many premium lounges at Denpasar offer a good selection of Indonesian dishes and international options.
meals.dinner: In-flight or at destination.

day_by_day.notes: Check out formalities should be completed the evening before to allow a relaxed final morning. Tip your hotel butler, driver, and any regular staff who enhanced your stay — this is deeply appreciated in Balinese culture. Carry any liquid purchases (oils, tonics, spirits) in checked luggage. Safe travels.
